items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 June 2026 4:55pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 11 June 2026 at 4:55pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, driving associated fronts across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time later in the night & at first tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional patchy rain at first and again tomorrow morning, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing West 5 or 6 occasionally 7 tomorrow evening, then decreasing 4 or 5 Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
